product.audience: Style-led young adults choosing expressive group looks for everyday wear, music, skate and festival culture
product.decision: Choose a coordinated three-person tee crew by colour, graphic and size while understanding fit and print construction
product.conversion: Issue a fictional crew drop pass with three chosen tees and valid contact details

signature.moment: Three full-height model lanes snap into a single joyful group portrait as the visitor assigns a tee, colour and size to every crew member

systems.hero: A sunlit block-party panorama split by three moving colour shutters; faces stay unobstructed while candid laughter and dance establish the label instantly
systems.navigation: A compact sound-system flight-strip with numbered set markers and a live three-slot crew counter
systems.contentDensity: Cinematic photo-led opening alternates with dense wearable product controls, macro craft evidence and short chant-like editorial beats
systems.geometry: Overlapping speaker-stack rectangles, torn-colour rails and three-person lanes; never a contact sheet, conventional product grid or luxury editorial column
systems.motion: Scroll moves colour shutters and crowd lanes at different speeds; state changes use short snap cuts and chromatic wipes that communicate selection
systems.coreInteraction: A three-slot crew mixer assigns tee colour, graphic and size per person, updates the live group composition and produces one complete drop pass

structuralDifferences: The hero becomes a portrait-first swipe-like story with explicit previous and next controls instead of the desktop panorama
The crew mixer becomes one person per step with a persistent progress wristband rather than three simultaneous lanes
The crowd wave becomes a compact vertical chant sequence before the product decision, while desktop uses a wide lateral photo stage
The completed result is a full-screen color-block pass in normal document flow, not an overlay or compressed desktop receipt

artDirection.typography: A heavy condensed display voice paired with warm humanist body copy and numeric mono details, all locally available system stacks
artDirection.material: Direct sunlight, on-camera fill flash, cotton grain, screen-print ink, painted asphalt and translucent festival wristband colour
artDirection.imageLogic: Original campaign photography carries people, styling and atmosphere; CSS supplies accessible brand lettering, shutters, diagrams and state indicators
artDirection.microcopy: Block, crew, colour hit, front print, back hit, fit, set, chorus, drop pass and sound-check language
artDirection.dataHonesty: Prices, stock, order codes and confirmations are explicitly labelled fictional template outcomes; fabric and print specifications are illustrative

adjacentTemplates.why: RIFT is a dark photographic proof sheet that selects one look and issues a size hold; LOUDER is a sunlit group stage assembling three coordinated people into one shared pass.
NOMA is a restrained coastal lookbook with isolated quick-shop drawers; LOUDER uses collective street culture, simultaneous crew lanes and an inline group outcome.
Maison Fold transforms pattern geometry into an atelier fitting dossier; LOUDER begins with real crowd photography and resolves a social three-person tee set.
PULSE moves one packaged product through pinned liquid worlds; LOUDER choreographs people and group choices with no persistent hero product or flavour ritual.
MOTIF expands one sculptural portal into agency case studies and enquiry overlays; LOUDER is a retail crew builder with human campaign imagery and an inline pass.

avoid: Darkroom contact sheets, film sprockets or claim tags
Single product pinned through interchangeable scene worlds
Luxury coastal restraint or couture atelier drafting language
Generic card grids, giant type covering faces, circular orbit CTAs or enquiry drawers
Mobile as a one-column desktop collapse
Uncontrolled flashing, endless autoplay or motion required to access content
